synthesis.evidence_balance: mixed — a real FCF-positive margin turnaround collides with a sharp Q1 revenue/operating-EBITDA collapse against 5.8x leverage and a 2026 maturity wall.

bull_points.claim: The multi-year margin turnaround is real and load-bearing: EBITDA margin swung from -118% (2021) to 17% (2025) with absolute EBITDA moving -180 to +74 over the same span, so this is a genuine profitability inflection, not an optical artifact.

bull_points.claim: The name is FCF-positive and self-funding, with LTM levered free cash flow of $39.6M, which materially reduces the terminal/dilution-spiral risk that sinks pre-profit battery names.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Cash Flow 'Levered Free Cash Flow' [LTM 12 months Mar-31-2026]

bull_points.claim: Interest coverage of 10.6x indicates the debt load is currently serviceable out of operating earnings despite the leverage optics.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Income Statement EBITDA ÷ Interest Expense [LTM 12 months Mar-31-2026]

bull_points.claim: On fundamentals the name screens BETTER than the peer median on several axes — EBITDA margin 14% vs 6%, EBITDA growth 21% vs 1% — posing whether the EV/EBITDA discount (11.1x vs peer median 14.5x) is a RESIDUAL overshoot rather than fully EARNED; but the peer set is flagged heterogeneous, so this is a confidence-gated input, not a clean benchmark.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Comparable Analysis→Operating Statistics (name vs peer median: growth/margin/leverage/beta)

bull_points.claim: Consensus forward path shows a recovery ramp — FY27E revenue $592M and FY27E EBITDA $148M vs LTM $372M/$52M — consistent with management's Phase 3.2 capacity narrative and a temporary-dip reading of Q1.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Income Statement + Cash Flow (annual) + Estimates→Trends (FY E)

bull_points.claim: Both covering brokers rate the name Buy with a $5.50 mean target, and recent GAAP net-income/EBT revisions were UPWARD (H.C. Wainwright FY26 EBT prior 59.42 → current 75.69), a genuine counter to the derating.

bear_points.claim: Revenue is contracting sharply, not just dipping: Q1-26 revenue fell to $61M with -37% QoQ and -25.5% YoY (Q1-26 vs Q1-24), and LTM revenue $372M is BELOW FY25 $428M — the top line is going backwards, the REAL signal, not an optical timing effect.

bear_points.claim: The Q1-26 EBITDA margin collapsed to 0% (absolute EBITDA ~$0 on $61M revenue) from 19% a year earlier — reading the % alongside the absolute confirms this is a genuine deterioration in the most recent quarter, not a margin-mix illusion.

bear_points.claim: Leverage is well above peers on the comps basis — total-debt/EBITDA 5.8x vs peer median 2.0x — and against a shrinking LTM EBITDA base this is a load-bearing EARNED component of the discount, not merely optical.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ Comparable Analysis→Operating Statistics (LTM Total Debt/EBITDA) · as-of 2026-06-24

bear_points.claim: There is a near-term maturity wall in 2026, including two shareholder convertible term loans (SOFR+9.750%) due 2026-05-28 and a China bank facility due 2026-12-10, concentrating refinancing/rollover risk against only $126M cash.

bear_points.claim: Consensus estimates have been cut hard through the derating — FY26 revenue -27% and FY26 EBITDA -52% (12m→latest) — and the stock fell -82% relative to the small-cap benchmark over 180d, so this is an idiosyncratic, estimate-driven collapse.
